summary: Phase 149O.19.5E -- HMIC Protected Admin Certification / Revocation Surface: bounded production implementation, Wave E of 5 under HMIC-001 v1.0 (docs/PHASE_149O_19_4_HATP_MANDATORY_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION_CERTIFICATION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md Sec9.2-9.5). Confirmed baseline via direct inspection: repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.19.5D completed/complete, hardcoded False ceiling unchanged, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable, no admin surface existed, no real HMIC state existed. Implements the sole production write-authority surface for HMIC certification state as scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py -- a new, standalone script outside src/pcae/, never imported by cli.py, commands/agent.py, or any other src/pcae/** module (AST-verified repository-wide). Zero changes to src/pcae/core/hatp_mandatory_certification.py: reuses every Wave A-C primitive unmodified (derive_repository_instance_id, derive_canonical_deployment_root, derive_implementation_commit, derive_implementation_scope_digest, derive_contract_versions, derive_certification_id, _append_certification_record, _write_active_binding, _write_revocation, load_certification). Implements three ceremonies: certify() (HMIC-REQ-076 steps 1-6, tool-derives the full authority tuple read-only, requires explicit confirmation via ConfirmationDeclinedError on decline, appends an immutable status=active record, never auto-activates), activate() (HMIC-REQ-088, a second explicit write binding an existing named certification_id as active, no implicit-latest selection, requires the candidate to exist/parse but never requires it to be currently VALID), and revoke() (HMIC-REQ-091-093, monotonic field mutation, explicit ID only, never clears the active binding). Real enforcement boundary is OS filesystem write permission on HATPTrustStore.production().root (Class-B, reused from 149O.1B.1) -- no --root override, no application-level fake-admin check of any kind. Minimized human-entered input: --repository-root (neutral locator, identical in kind to the Wave-D validator's own parameter), --certified-by (audit metadata), --verification-record-path (a file locator the tool hashes itself, never a caller-supplied digest); certification_id never caller-suppliable for creation. Added a 33-test Wave-E suite (tests/test_phase_149o_19_5e_hmic_protected_admin_certification_revocation.py) covering create/idempotent/decline, activate/no-implicit-latest/no-pre-validation-invented, revoke/monotonic/no-binding-clear, a 4-thread identical-creation race and a 2-thread supersession race (both deterministic, no torn state), 2-repository isolation over one shared protected root, AST-based zero-agent-reachable-caller and zero-forbidden-import checks, and a path-traversal-shaped-certification-id rejection test. Widened one 149O.19.5A-era stale scope-boundary assertion in place (deliberate, mirrors Wave D's own prior precedent of updating Wave C's test file): test_no_admin_script_created renamed to test_admin_script_absent_or_exactly_wave_e_owned, restated to assert what remains permanently true (if the admin script exists, it is the sole Wave-E-owned file at that path, and no *certification_admin*-named file exists anywhere under src/pcae/) rather than the now-superseded 'does not exist yet' snapshot. Clean deselected run (all 33 named explicitly): 0 failed. No real certification state created; no real activation occurred. B-149O.19.3-1 remains independently closed, unchanged. B-149O-1..4 verdict unchanged, carried forward: INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED CLOSED AT SYSTEM IMPLEMENTATION/ENFORCEMENT BOUNDARY -- DEPLOYMENT/OPERATIONAL ACTIVATION DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Verdict: HMIC PROTECTED ADMIN CERTIFICATION / REVOCATION SURFACE: IMPLEMENTED -- WAVE A-E IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE -- W-1 CONTRACT-EVOLUTION GATE NOW MANDATORY (not ready for Wave F).
